notebooks.neqsim_version: 3.17.0 Python bridge with the Java runtime source-built from current equinor/neqsim master
notebooks.execution_method: Executed all 24 code cells sequentially from an empty in-process IPython namespace with scripts/execute_notebook_inprocess.py. The run used a GitHub Actions source-built runtime JAR from the exact recorded NeqSim master commit, retained all numerical tables and eight PNG figures, and produced zero stored errors and zero stderr streams.
neqsim_capabilities_demonstrated: SRK and PR multistage CO2-rich compression with intercooling, shaft power, cooler duty, and mass closure
EOS-CG and GERG-2008 equilibrium density and phase audits for CO2 with nitrogen, oxygen, and argon
EOS-CG final-cooler temperature and impurity phase map
PR and SRK isenthalpic mixture relief paths
reference-EOS audit gates at dense and model-sensitive states
independent_validation: Span-Wagner pure-CO2 density and saturation calculations through CoolProp HEOS
published EOS-CG, EOS-CG-2021, GERG-2008, and CO2 blowdown literature
transient rigid-vessel mass and energy balances with a lumped metal wall

checks: EOS-CG pure-CO2 density within 0.1 percent of the reference
EOS-CG detected the nominal two-phase final state at 25 degC
HEM critical maxima were interior and positive
blowdown stopped above the triple pressure
fluid temperature approached the triple temperature without crossing the fluid-model boundary
the lumped wall remained warmer than the final fluid

rendered_visual_validation.renderer: nbconvert 7.17.1 Jupyter HTML with MathJax source and retained inline Matplotlib PNG
rendered_visual_validation.notes: All equations and all eight retained figures were inspected after the final source-built execution and again after repository-size PNG optimization. Symbols, units, labels, legends, phase boundaries, triple-point limits, color contrast, clipping, overlap, and consistency with the retained result tables all passed.

notebooks.documentation_impact: The main NeqSim-Colab notebook catalog is updated with a direct relative link and a concise description. No public NeqSim API, default, or installation interface is changed.
notebooks.issue_handling: No distinct NeqSim defect or missing API invalidating the study was identified. The notebook explicitly limits fluid-only calculations at the CO2 triple boundary and treats certified relief sizing, solid formation, and detailed wall-temperature assessment as separate qualified workflows.
